source_note: Short paraphrases written for this project. X12 owns the official Claim Adjustment Reason Code (CARC) list and its wording, so these are not the official text. Official list: https://x12.org/codes/claim-adjustment-reason-codes
label_caveat: In this project the denial label is synthetic (engineered from risk rules on CMS synthetic claims), so a CARC attached to a claim here is illustrative, not an observed payer decision.

11.description: The diagnosis doesn't support the procedure billed.

16.description: The claim is missing information or has a billing error.

18.description: Duplicate of a claim or service already submitted.

181.description: The procedure code wasn't valid on the date of service.
